full_judgment: 2. An application under section 96 of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act was filed by the predecessor-in-interest of the respondent Nos. 1-12 along with respondent No. 13 in the 1st court of Munsif, Sylhet for pre-emption of .33 acre of land of case plot No. 5209 out of total 3.36 acres of land of 16 plots purchased by the appellant by a single kabala dated 3-4-72. Their case is that they are co-sharers by purchase and owners of contiguous land and as such they are entitled to partial pre-emption on proportionate consideration of Tk. 1,035/- out of total consideration of Tk. 10,000/-. The pre-emptee-appellant and respondent Nos. 14 and 15 who arc vendors contested the case by filing a joint written objection. Their case is that the pre-emptors are not entitled to any relief without making deposit of Tk. 10,000/-, they are not co-sharers of the holding and have no land contiguous to the lands sold, they have no land to the contiguous north and east of the plot and that the proportionate value of the case land will be at least Tk. 2,000/- being the best land of the entire lot sold under the kabala. Also the case was bad for non joinder of necessary parties. Pre-emptee-appellant did not, however, contest the case at the time of trial.
